guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「進料排程、氣固輸送與封閉收集」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow inlet scheduling, gas-solid transport and enclosed collection through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「住戶投料與尖峰」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 400 kg/day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以平均值排程可能在投料尖峰滿槽。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「入口暫存容積」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.8 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只用重量監測可能漏掉低密度垃圾塞滿入口。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「管內氣流速度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 15.9155 m/s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把風機標況流量直接當每處實際流量會偏估速度。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「支路壓降與彎管」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 270 Pa，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以清氣壓降當載料總壓降會低估風機需求。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「批次調度與互斥」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.6 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只依入口各自需求啟動可能造成共享管段過載。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「漏氣與風量損失」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.7 m3/s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「漏氣可能讓風機耗電正常卻輸送失敗。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「分離器與排氣」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.98 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「高總捕集率可能掩蓋細粉穿透。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「風機電耗邊界」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30.7692 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只看額定功率而忽略運轉時數會誤判能耗。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「堵塞診斷與隔離」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 8 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未確認隔離就增加輸送次數可能加劇堵塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「物流終端與效益比較」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 kWh/tonne，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只比較路邊車次會漏掉地下系統耗能。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for household input and peaks, first reproduce 400 kg/day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Average-based schedules can overflow storage at peaks." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for inlet storage volume, first reproduce 0.8 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mass-only monitoring can miss volume blockage by light waste." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for air speed in the pipe, first reproduce 15.9155 m/s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using standardized fan flow as local actual flow misestimates speed." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for branch losses and bends, first reproduce 270 Pa, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Clean-air pressure loss understates loaded transport demand." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for batch scheduling and mutual exclusion, first reproduce 0.6 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Independent inlet triggers can overload shared pipe segments." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for leaks and lost air capacity, first reproduce 1.7 m3/s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Leaks can cause failed transport despite apparently normal fan power." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for separator and exhaust, first reproduce 0.98 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "High bulk capture can hide fine-particle penetration." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for fan electricity boundary, first reproduce 30.7692 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Rated power without operating hours misjudges energy." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for blockage diagnosis and isolation, first reproduce 8 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Repeated transport without diagnosis can worsen a blockage." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for terminal logistics and comparison, first reproduce 30 kWh/tonne, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Roadside truck counts alone omit underground-system energy." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 比較分散投料與晚間集中投料。
加入蓬鬆紙箱情境，保持質量但降低密度。
改變管徑並觀察速度與可輸送物尺寸限制。
比較有無彎管的教學壓差並標出模型缺項。
加上一批延遲，檢查衝突與剩餘裕度。
逐段隔離教學閥門並記錄壓力恢復。
將粗垃圾和粉塵分開做質量收支。
保持質量輸送任務比較兩種批次長度的電量。
加入一個假想堵塞，觀察壓差和質量差是否同時變化。
納入終端車輛與風機後比較相同收集量。
evidenceEn: Add bulky-cardboard conditions at equal mass and lower density.
Vary diameter and inspect speed and item-size constraints.
Compare teaching pressure drops with/without a bend and list missing physics.
Add one delayed batch and check conflicts and margin.
Isolate simulated valves sequentially and record pressure recovery.
Balance coarse waste and fine dust separately.
Compare electricity for two batch durations at equal transported mass.
Inject a simulated blockage and compare pressure and mass residuals.
Include terminal vehicles and fans for equal collected mass.
pitfalls: 以平均值排程可能在投料尖峰滿槽。
只用重量監測可能漏掉低密度垃圾塞滿入口。
把風機標況流量直接當每處實際流量會偏估速度。
以清氣壓降當載料總壓降會低估風機需求。
只依入口各自需求啟動可能造成共享管段過載。
漏氣可能讓風機耗電正常卻輸送失敗。
高總捕集率可能掩蓋細粉穿透。
只看額定功率而忽略運轉時數會誤判能耗。
未確認隔離就增加輸送次數可能加劇堵塞。
只比較路邊車次會漏掉地下系統耗能。
pitfallsEn: Average-based schedules can overflow storage at peaks.
Mass-only monitoring can miss volume blockage by light waste.
Using standardized fan flow as local actual flow misestimates speed.
Clean-air pressure loss understates loaded transport demand.
Independent inlet triggers can overload shared pipe segments.
Leaks can cause failed transport despite apparently normal fan power.
High bulk capture can hide fine-particle penetration.
Rated power without operating hours misjudges energy.
Repeated transport without diagnosis can worsen a blockage.
Roadside truck counts alone omit underground-system energy.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 資源回收廠光學分選
related.titleEn: Optical sorting in materials recovery facilities
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
